097  /**
098   * Use this if you want a 1-1 correspondence between {@code RowSet} and {@code RowsModel};
099   * for 1-1 only this method should be used.
100   * If an existing RowsModel for the RowSet is
101   * not found, a new RowsModel is created.
102   * If {@link RowsModel#create(javax.sql.RowSet) }
103   * is used multiple RowsModel can be created for the same RowSet;
104   * and see {@link RowsModel#getActiveRowModels(javax.sql.RowSet) }
105   * <p>
106   * Can also use as a transition aid to RowsModel.
107   * @param rs
108   * @return
109   */
110  // TODO: could throw exception if more than one model for specified RowSet.
111  public static RowsModel findRowsModel(RowSet rs) {
112    RowsModel rowsModel = RowsModel.getActiveRowModel(rs);
113    if (rowsModel == null)
114      rowsModel = RowsModel.create(rs);
115    return rowsModel;
116  }

130  /**
131   * Recursively find the {@link SsComponent}s in container and
132   * visit them.
133   *
134   * @param container
135   * @param visitor
136   */
137  public static void visitSsComponents(Container container, Consumer<SsComponent> visitor) {
138    // TODO: should more components have cleanField?
139    final Component[] comps = container.getComponents();
140    for (Component comp : comps) {
141      switch (comp) {
142        case SsComponent c ->
143          visitor.accept(c);
144          // Could also have a VisitAsSsComponent interface
145          // Would mark SsComponent, param becomes Consumer<VisitAsSsComponent>
146          // case VisitAsSsComponent c -> visitor.accept(c)
147
148        case JRootPane c -> visitSsComponents(c, visitor);
149        case JPanel c -> visitSsComponents(c, visitor);
150        case JLayeredPane c -> visitSsComponents(c, visitor);
151        case JTabbedPane c -> visitSsComponents(c, visitor);
152        case JScrollPane c -> visitSsComponents(c.getViewport(), visitor);
153        default -> {
154          // TODO: have a plugin that take "c" and returns true/false
155          //       for whether or not it should be visited;
156          //       i.e. if it should be treated like a container.
157        }
158      }
159    }
160  }

177  /**
178   * Get the size of a map taking into account possible weak keys.
179   *
180   * @param map get size of this map
181   * @return map size
182   */
183  @SuppressWarnings("null")
184  public static int size(Map<?, ?> map) {
185    if (!(map instanceof ConcurrentMap))
186      return map.size();
187    // Can't depend on size() method when weakKeys.
188    int counter = 0;
189    for (Map.Entry<?, ?> _ : map.entrySet()) {
190      counter++;
191    }
192    return counter;
193  }

195  /**
196   * Returns the lookup's current DbSupport.
197   * Very fast; it listens.
198   * @return DbSupport
199   */
200  public static DbSupport dbSupport() {
201    if (dbSupport == null) {
202      dbSupportResult = CentralLookup.getDefault().lookupResult(DbSupport.class);
203      dbSupportResult.addLookupListener((LookupEvent le) -> {
204        dbSupportResult.allInstances().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(item -> dbSupport = item);
205      });
206      dbSupportResult.allInstances().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(item -> dbSupport = item);
207      if (dbSupport == null)
208        throw new IllegalStateException("SsDBSupport not found");
209    }
210    return dbSupport;
211  }
212  private static DbSupport dbSupport;
213  private static Lookup.Result<DbSupport> dbSupportResult;

215  /**
216   * Setup a {@linkplain CachedRowSet}'s primary keys, use the component's
217   * row set to get the database table's keys.
218   * If not a CachedRowSet or the key is already set, do nothing.
219   * Note a JoinRowSet is skipped; only want to set keys for single table.
220   * @param comp component
221   */
222  // TODO: Could have an array of primary keys, one entry per column.
223  //         Could this be needed for joins?
224  public static void setupDefaultPrimaryKeys(SsComponent comp) {
225    RowSet rs = comp.getRowSet();
226    if (rs instanceof JoinRowSet)
227      return;
228    if (!(rs instanceof CachedRowSet crs))
229      return;
230    try {
231      if (crs.getKeyColumns() != null)
232        return;
233      int[] keys = getPrimaryKeyColumns(SsUtils.dbSupport().getSharedConnection(), crs);
234      crs.setKeyColumns(keys);
235    } catch (SQLException ex) {
236    }
237  }
238  private static int[] getPrimaryKeyColumns(Connection connection, CachedRowSet crs)
239      throws SQLException {
240    return getPrimaryKeyColumns(connection.getMetaData(), crs);
241  }
242
243  private static int[] getPrimaryKeyColumns(DatabaseMetaData dbMetaData, CachedRowSet crs)
244      throws SQLException {
245    ResultSetMetaData rsMetaData = crs.getMetaData();
246
247    int colIdx = 1; // columns from same CachedRowSet; should have same stuff. TRUE?
248    String catalog = rsMetaData.getCatalogName(colIdx);
249    String schema = rsMetaData.getSchemaName(colIdx);
250    String table = rsMetaData.getTableName(colIdx);
251    List<KeyInfo> kinfo = getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(dbMetaData, catalog, schema, table);
252
253    int[] keyCols = new int[kinfo.size()];
254    for (KeyInfo ki : kinfo) keyCols[ki.keySeq - 1] = crs.findColumn(ki.columnName);
255    return keyCols;
256  }
257
258  public record KeyInfo(int keySeq, String columnName) {}
259
260  // TODO: keys: should spec catalog/schema?
261  /**
262   * @param dbMetaData
263   * @param catalog
264   * @param schema
265   * @param tableName
266   * @return
267   * @throws SQLException
268   */
269  public static List<KeyInfo> getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(DatabaseMetaData dbMetaData, String catalog,
270                                                        String schema, String tableName)
271      throws SQLException {
272    // TODO: some versions of Postgress require null catalog. But in this file
273    //       catalog comes from rsMetaData.getCatalogName() which I'm guessing
274    //       returns null.
275    try (ResultSet pKeys = dbMetaData.getPrimaryKeys(catalog, schema, tableName);) {
276      List<KeyInfo> keyInfo = new ArrayList<>(3);
277      while (pKeys.next()) {
278        keyInfo.add(new KeyInfo(pKeys.getInt("KEY_SEQ"), pKeys.getString("COLUMN_NAME")));
279      }
280      return keyInfo;
281    }
282  }

304  /**
305   * Find {@link KeyInfo} for table associated with the specified column.
306   * Starting with the column's RowSet, get the dbMetaData, determine keys.
307   * @param rs
308   * @param colIdx
309   * @return
310   * @throws SQLException
311   */
312  // TODO: isKey: lookup specializations for databases to access special result set info.
313  //public static List<KeyInfo> getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(RSC comp)
314  public static List<KeyInfo> getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(RowSet rs, int colIdx) throws SQLException {
315    // TODO: isKey: this doesn't seem reliable. Consider join...
316    // TODO: isKey: For now assume column names match
317
318    ResultSetMetaData rsMetaData = rs.getMetaData();
319
320    String catalog = rsMetaData.getCatalogName(colIdx);
321    String schema = rsMetaData.getSchemaName(colIdx);
322    String table = rsMetaData.getTableName(colIdx);
323
324    // TODO: just call all the names keys. Buggy if join ...
325    List<KeyInfo> ki = SsUtils.dbSupport().runWithConnection(conn -> {
326      // Note: can not use database cache because this is specifically for table.
327      DatabaseMetaData dbMetaData = conn.getMetaData();
328      // TODO: some versions of Postgress require null catalog
329      return getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(dbMetaData, catalog, schema, table);
330    });
331    return ki;
332  }

389  /**
390   * Report problem accessing image file to user.
391   * @param logger
392   * @param comp
393   * @param title dialog title
394   * @param path file path
395   * @param ex error
396   */
397  // TODO: Only used from Image.java. Does this belong in Image.java?
398  public static void reportError(Logger logger, SsComponent comp, String title, Path path,
399                                 Exception ex) {
400    String pathName = path != null ? path.toAbsolutePath().toString() : "";
401    logger.log(Level.ERROR,
402               () -> sf("%s: IO Exception %s: file %s: %s", comp.getColumnForLog(),
403                        ex.getClass().getSimpleName(), pathName, ex.getMessage()));
404
405    // TODO: Alter message according to parameters.
406    //       For example, if path is null, leave out "file: 'xxx'"
407
408    String msg = sf("<html>"
409                        + "<center>%s</center>"
410                        + "<br/>Details:<br/>"
411                        + "<center>DB column: %s</center>"
412                        + "<center>File: '%s'</center>"
413                        + "<center>Exception: %s</center>",
414                    ex.getLocalizedMessage(), comp.getColumnForLog(), pathName,
415                    ex.getClass().getSimpleName());
416    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog((Component) comp, msg, title, JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
417  }

433  /**
434   * Return a unique name for an Object, for example "String@89AB".
435   * Name is SimpleClassName followed by identityHashCode in hex.
436   * Used primarily for debug messages.
437   * @param o The Object
438   * @return unique name for the object or "null"
439   */
440  // TODO: put this in utils/SsUtil
441  public static String objectID(Object o) {
442    if (o == null) {
443      return "null";
444    }
445    String s = switch (o) {
446      case RowSet rs ->
447        sf("%s[%s]@%X", o.getClass().getSimpleName(), tableName(rs), System.identityHashCode(o));
448      default -> sf("%s@%X", o.getClass().getSimpleName(), System.identityHashCode(o));
449    };
450    return s;
451  }

466  private static boolean isJunit;
467  private static boolean didJunitCheck;
468  /**
469   * @return true if junit is running.
470   */
471  public static boolean isJunit() {
472    if (!didJunitCheck) {
473      //.filter((f)->{System.err.println("    "+f.getClassName());return true; })
474      StackWalker walker = StackWalker.getInstance(Option.RETAIN_CLASS_REFERENCE);
475      Optional<StackWalker.StackFrame> frame
476          = walker.walk(s -> s.filter((f) -> f.getClassName().startsWith("org.junit")).findFirst());
477      if (frame.isPresent())
478        isJunit = true;
479      didJunitCheck = true;
480    }
481    return isJunit;
482  }
483
484  /** Set when junit tests set up a logger. */
485  public static String JUNIT_TEST_LOGGING = "JUNIT_TEST_LOGGING";
486
487  /**
488   * true if in JUnit and NOT using JUnit logging
489   * @return
490   */
491  public static boolean isJunitPrint() {
492    if (!isJunit())
493      return false;
494    return !System.getProperty(JUNIT_TEST_LOGGING).equals("true");
495  }
